book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Yesun bwɑ̃ɑ ɡbiikobun sokubu
Ye Yesu u yɔ̃rɑ dɑɑ burerun bɔkuɔ te bɑ rɑ soku Genɛsɑrɛti, tɔn wɔru ɡɑ nùn mɛnnɛ ɡu kɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri nɔ.
Mɑ u ɡoosu yiru wɑ dɑɑ bure ten ɡoorɔ sìn min di swɛ̃ɛ ɡowobu bɑ sɑrɑ bɑ ben yɑ̃ɑkoronu teɔ dɑ.
Mɑ u duɑ ɡoo sin teu sɔɔ ɡe ɡɑ sɑ̃ɑ Simɔɔɡuu, mɑ u nùn kɑnɑ u kɑ ɡu ɡooru tondɑsiɑ fiiko. Yen biru u sinɑ u tɔn wɔrusu Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔ̃ɔsimɔ ɡen min di.
Ye u win ɡɑri ɡerubu mɑri, u Simɔɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn ɡoo bɔrieyo bwerɔ kpɑ i bɛɛn yɑ̃ɑkoronu kpɛ̃ɛ i kɑ swɛ̃ɛ mwɑ.
Simɔɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yinni wɔ̃ku ɡirirɑ sɑ sɔmburu kuɑ, sɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑ sɑ mwɛ, ɑdɑmɑ wunɛn ɡɑrin sɔ̃ kon yɑ̃ɑkoro te kpɛ̃ɛ.
Ye bɑ kuɑ mɛ, bɑ swɛ̃ɛ dɑbi dɑbiru ɡurɑ sere ben yɑ̃ɑkororɑ ɡɛ̃ɛrɔ.
Mɑ bɑ kɑ yĩreru ben berusebu sokɑ be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡoo yiruse sɔɔ bu nɑ bu bu somi. Bɑ nɑ mɑ bɑ ɡoosu yiru ye swɛ̃ɛ yibiɑ sere su kĩ su num.
Ye Simɔɔ Piɛɛ u yeni wɑ u kpunɑ Yesun wuswɑɑɔ u nɛɛ, Yinni, ɑ tii ɡɑwo nɛn bɔkun di, domi nɛ torowɑ.
Domi wi kɑ win berusebu kpuro bɑ biti kuɑ swɛ̃ɛ dɑbi ten sɔ̃ te bɑ ɡurɑ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ biti yɑ Simɔɔn berusebu Yɑkɔbu kɑ Yohɑnu, Sebeden bibu mwɑ. Yesu u Simɔɔ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ku bɛrum ko, sɑɑ tɛ̃n di tɔmbɑ kɑɑ n kɑsu bu mɑn swĩi.
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ kɑ ben ɡoosu dɑ ɡoorɔ, mɑ bɑ si kpuro deri bɑ nùn swĩi.
Yesu u wi u bɑrɑ disiɡiru bɑrɔ
bɛkiɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u wɑ̃ɑ wuu ɡɑɡu sɔɔ durɔ ɡoo wi u bɑrɑ disiɡiru bɑrɔ u nùn wɑ, mɑ u yiirɑ win wuswɑɑɔ u nùn suuru kɑnɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni ɑ̀ n wurɑ, nɑ yɛ̃ mɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ mɑn bɛkiɑ kpɑ n dɛɛrɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u win nɔmu dɛmiɑ u nùn bɑbɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ wurɑ, ɑ bɛkuro kpɑ ɑ dɛɛrɑ. Mii mii bɑrɑ disiɡii te, tɑ nùn doonɑri.
Yesu u nùn yiire u nɛɛ, u ku rɑɑ ɡoo ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ u doo u win tii yɑ̃ku kowo tusiɑ, kpɑ u yɑ̃kuru ko win dɛɛrɑsiɑbun sɔ̃ nɡe mɛ Mɔwisin woodɑ yɑ ɡeruɑ, kpɑ tu kɑ ko seedɑ tɔmbun wuswɑɑɔ.
Kɑ mɛ, win lɑbɑɑri yɑ yɑbi, mɑ tɔn dɑbirɑ mɛnnɑmɔ bu kɑ win ɡɑri nɔ, kpɑ bu kɑ bɛkurɑ ben bɑrɑnu sɔɔn di.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u rɑ dewɑ ɡbɑburɔ wi turo u n kɑnɑru mɔ̀.
Yesu u durɔ ɡoo bɛkiɑ
wìn wɑsin bee tiɑ ɡu
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Yesu u Gusunɔn ɡɑrin keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɑ Fɑlisibɑ kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu bɑ sɔ̃ mi, be bɑ nɑ sɑɑ Gɑlile kɑ Yudeɑn wuu bɑɑɡeren di, kɑ mɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di, mɑ Yinnin dɑm mu derɑ u bɑrɔbu bɛkiɑmɔ.
Sɑɑ ye yɑnde, tɔmbu ɡɑbɑ durɔ ɡoo sɔɔwɑ kɑ kpinu wìn wɑsin bee tiɑ yɑ ɡu. Bɑ kɑsu mɛ bɑ koo kɑ du kpɑ bu nùn yi Yesun wuswɑɑɔ.
Ye bɑ kun wɑ mi bɑ koo kɑ nùn duusiɑ tɔn wɔrun sɔ̃, yerɑ bɑ yɔɔwɑ diru mi u wɑ̃ɑn wɔllɔ, mɑ bɑ tu yɑbɑ bɑ nùn sɑrɑsiɑ kɑ win kpinu tɔn wɔru ɡen suunu sɔɔ Yesun wuswɑɑɔ.
Ye u ben nɑɑnɛ dokebu wɑ, yerɑ u durɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn durum suuru wɑ.
Woodɑ yɛ̃robu kɑ Fɑlisibɑ bɑ bwisikum wɔri bɑ tii bikiɑmɔ, wɑrɑ wini wi u Gusunɔ wɔmmɔ. Wɑrɑ koo kpĩ u tɔnu win durum suuru kuɑ mɑ n kun mɔ Gusunɔ turo.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u ben bwisikunu ɡiɑ mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i bwisikumɔ mɛ bɛɛn ɡɔ̃ruɔ.
Yen yerɑ̀ yɑ sɛ̃sɔ bo, bu nɛɛ, bɑ tɔnu nùn win durum suuru kuɑ, ǹ kun mɛ bu nɛɛ, u seewo u sĩ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, kon bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ Tɔnun Bii, u yiiko mɔ hɑnduniɑ mi, u kɑ durum suuru ko. Mɑ u bɑrɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɑ seewo ɑ wunɛn kpinu suɑ kpɑ ɑ we yɛnuɔ.
Mɑ u seewɑ mii mii ben wuswɑɑɔ u suɑ ye u rɑɑ kpunɑri, mɑ u Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ u kɑ dɔɔ yɛnuɔ.
Yerɑ biti yɑ be kpuro mwɑ mɑ bɑ Gusunɔ siɑrɑmɔ. Bɛrum mɑɑ bu mwɑ mɑ bɑ mɔ̀, sɑ ɡɑ̃ɑ mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu wɑ ɡisɔ.
Yesu u Lefi sokɑ
Yenibɑn biru Yesu u yɑrɑ mɑ u ɡbere mwɑɔ ɡoo wɑ wi bɑ rɑ soku Lefi u sɔ̃ ɡbere yerɔ, mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn swĩiyɔ.
Lefi u seewɑ u ye kpuro deri mɑ u nùn swĩi.
Yen biru u Yesu tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑ dim kuɑ win yɛnuɔ. Gbere mwɑɔ dɑbinu kɑ mɑɑ ɡɑbu bɑ kɑ bu dimɔ.
Fɑlisibɑ kɑ ben woodɑ yɛ̃robu ɡɑbu bɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkisi bɑ bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i dimɔ i nɔrumɔ kɑ ɡbere mwɑɔbu kɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowobu.
Yesu u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, be bɑ bwɑ̃ɑ do bɑ ǹ timɡiin bukɑtɑ mɔ mɑ n kun mɔ be bɑ bɑrɔ.
Nɑ ǹ nɛ n kɑ ɡeeɡibu soku. Nɑ nɑwɑ n kɑ kɔ̃sɑn kowobu soku bu kɑ ben ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ.
Nɔɔ bɔkurun ɡɑri
Bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Yohɑnun bwɑ̃ɑbu kɑ Fɑlisibɑɡibu bɑ rɑ nɔɔ bɔke kiri kiri, bɑ rɑ mɑɑ kɑnɑru ko, ɑdɑmɑ wunɛɡibɑ dimɔ bɑ nɔrumɔ.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, i ko i kpĩ i kurɔ kpɑon durɔn bɔrɔbɑ nɔɔ bɔkusiɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ be?
Adɑmɑ sɑnɑm wee mɛ bɑ koo kurɔ kpɑon durɔ wɔrɑ ben nɔmɑn di. Sɑnɑm mɛ sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo nɔɔ bɔke.
U mɑɑ bu mɔndu kuɑ u nɛɛ, bɑ ku rɑ yɑbe kpɑɑru ɡĩɛ bu kɑ yɑbe tɔkɔru kɔre. Bɑ̀ n kuɑ mɛ, bɑ koo kpɑɑru ɡĩɑ, kpɑɑrun yɑsɑ mɑɑ yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ nɛnɛm yɑbe tɔkɔru sɔɔ.
Goo ku rɑ mɑɑ tɑm kpɑm doke ɡɔnɑn bɔɔ tɔkɔnu sɔɔ. Ù n kuɑ mɛ, tɑm kpɑm mɛ, mu koo bɔɔnu kurɑsiɑ kpɑ mu yɑri, kpɑ bɔɔnu nu sɑnkirɑ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ koo ko bɑ kun tɑm kpɑm doke bɔɔ kpɑɑnu sɔɔ.
Goo sɑri wi u ko n tɑm kpɑm kĩ, sɑnɑm mɛ u tɑm ɡurum nɔrɑ, domi u koo ɡere u nɛɛ, ɡurum kɑ nùn nɛrenɑ.
